### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activity A01 was not observed at all (0 of 200 traces); in the later window it runs in about 47 in 100 traces (94 of 200), roughly once per trace on average, recurring in about a quarter of the traces that contain it, and it sits around the middle of the trace (median relative position about 0.34, middle half between about 0.20 and 0.60). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the later window, the activities that previously fed A04 now route through A01: of A03's observed outgoing transitions, the share to A04 fell from about 53% to about 10% while a new share of about 42% goes to A01; A11 sends about 76% of its outgoing transitions to A01 (about 96% went to A04 before, now about 22%); A10 sends about 25% to A01 (its share to A04 fell from about 47% to about 13%). A01's own outgoing transitions go mainly to A04 (about 76%), with smaller shares to A13 (about 10%) and A11 (about 7%). [DIR001, DIR002, DIR004, DIR005]
- Pairs involving A01 changed from never co-occurring to frequent co-occurrence: A01 and A04 now co-occur in about 47 in 100 traces (A01 first in about 20, interleaved or repeated in about 23); A01 and A03 in about 27 (A03 first in about 15); A01 and A10 in about 20; A01 and A11 in about 23 (mostly interleaved or repeated). In the earlier window all four pairs had zero co-occurrence because A01 never appeared. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004]
- Distances between existing activity pairs shifted about one event position later: A03→A04 from distance 1 (about 55 in 100 observations) to distance 2 (about 62); A10→A04 from distance 1 (about 47) to distance 2 (about 51); A11→A04 from distance 1 (about 23) to distance 2 (about 32); A03→A11 from distance 3 (all observations) to distance 4 (about 91); A10→A11 from distance 3 (about 81) to distance 4 (about 82); A11→A11 from distance 3 (about 33) to distance 4 (about 47); A04→A04 from distance 3 (about 40) to distance 4 (about 30); A04→A11 shifted modestly later (distance 2 in about 23 to about 36). [LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]
- A04 itself is otherwise stable: its outgoing transitions still go almost entirely to A13 (about 99% before, about 89% after, plus a new small share of about 10% to A01), and its position barely moved (mean relative position about 0.39 to 0.44; share of traces containing it about 55% to 47%). [DIR003, POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, A01 is executed as a step inserted into existing flows: sequences that previously ran from A03 — and, less uniformly, from A10 and A11 — directly on to A04 now typically pass through A01 first, and A01 in turn leads mainly to A04. Twenty control-flow items qualified against an expectation of about 0.23 without change, so the set of differences is far larger than chance would produce. The hypothesis is shown directly rather than inferred from a single indicator: A01 rises from none of 200 traces to about 94 in 200; A03, A10 and A11 reroute away from A04 towards A01 while about three quarters of A01's outgoing transitions go to A04; the new relations show A03 before A01 and A01 before A04; and existing pair distances lengthen by about one event position, as expected if a step now sits between them. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR002, DIR004, DIR005, REL001, REL002, LAG001, LAG002]

Limitations: A01's placement is not fixed — it also receives small shares from other predecessors, interleaves or is repeated with A04 in about 23 in 100 traces, and several lag items rest on only about 22–26 observations; the agreeing indicators partly describe the same trace behaviour and are not independent confirmations. A competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is that A01 belonged to a variant already present below detection in the earlier window, although 0 versus about 94 of 200 traces makes sampling noise alone implausible. [REL002, REL004, LAG002, LAG006, LAG008, OCC001]

Let me analyse this evidence carefully.

Schema: pcr-evidence-2.1. Two windows of 200 traces each. Screening: 46 units tested, 20 items qualified, 0.23 expected without change. All items are control_flow family (CF_OCC, CF_DIR, CF_POS, CF_REL, CF_LAG). No time items (TWAIT) and no resource items (ASSIGN, CONC, HAND), so I must not discuss time or resources.

Screening comparison: 20 items vs 0.23 expected. That's many times larger (about 87x). So the count cannot be explained by chance as a whole. So we go beyond "insufficient evidence" on the count basis. Now judge by directness, consistency, ability to rule out competing explanations.

Main behavioural story:

OCC001: A01 absent before (0 occurrences, 0 participation), after: mean 0.96 occurrences per trace, participation 0.47 (47 in 100 traces), recurrence support 0.23. So A01 was not observed at all before and appears in about 47 in 100 traces after, sometimes repeated (recurrence 0.23). This is an activity added / became present. Not a shift in path frequencies — A01 was (nearly) absent in one window.

DIR001: outgoing transitions of A01: before empty (A01 never occurred), after: mostly to A04 (about 76% of observed outgoing transitions), then A13 (~10%), A11 (~7%), A12 (~4%), A10 (~3%), A03, A06 small. Support after 192.

DIR002: A03's outgoing transitions redistributed: before, A03 went mostly to A04 (about 53%), A02 (32%), A07 (12%), A12 (2%), A09 (1%). After: A01 (42%), A02 (29%), A04 (10%), A07 (15%), A13 (2%), A12 (1%). So A03 now often goes to A01 instead of A04. Support 99 before, 97 after — substantial.

DIR003: A04's outgoing: before mostly A13 (99%), after A13 (89%) plus A01 (10%). Small change (observed_change 0.0062 cosine dissimilarity — tiny). Interesting: empirical strength 0.995 but observed change tiny. Note: empirical strength is high for all items — that's suspicious; it's 0.995 for every item, which is the qualification threshold presumably. The observed_change for DIR003 is 0.0062, which is very small. So DIR003 is a minor change: A04 now sometimes followed by A01.

DIR004: A10's outgoing redistributed: before A04 (47%), A07 (20%), A02 (15%), A12, A08, A11, A09, A13, A05. After: A02 (25%), A07 (28%), A01 (25%), A04 (13%), others. So A10 now often goes to A01 (25%) instead of A04 (47%→13%). Support 94/97.

DIR005: A11's outgoing: before A04 (96%), after A01 (76%), A04 (22%). Big redistribution. Support 111/98.

POS001: A01 position: before no support; after support 0.47, mean position ~0.39 of the trace (normalized position presumably), median 0.34, q25 0.2, q75 0.6. So A01 occurs around the middle of traces.

POS002: A04 position: before support 0.545, mean 0.389; after support 0.47, mean 0.443. Slight shift later. Small change (0.055).

REL001 (A01, A03): before: A03 only in 49.5% of traces, neither 50.5%, never co-occurring (A01 absent). After: co-occurrence 27%, A_only (A01 only) 20%, B_only (A03 only) 22%, neither 31%, B_before_A 14.5%, interleaved 12%, A_before_B 0.5%. So A01 and A03 now often occur together, usually A03 before A01.

REL002 (A01, A04): before: A04 only 54.5%, neither 45.5%. After: co-occurrence 47%, A_before_B (A01 before A04) 19.5%, B_before_A 4.5%, interleaved 23%, neither 53%. So A01 and A04 now usually co-occur, often A01 before A04.

REL003 (A01, A10): before A10 only 50.5%; after co-occurrence 20%, A_only 27%, B_only 31%, neither 22%, B_before_A 6.5%, interleaved 11%. So they now sometimes co-occur.

REL004 (A01, A11): before A11 only 24.5%, neither 75.5%; after co-occurrence 23%, A_only 24%, interleaved 23%, neither 53%. So A01 and A11 now co-occur about 23 in 100, interleaved or repeated 23%.

LAG items: distances between pairs shifted.

LAG001 (A03→A04 within 5 steps): before distance 1 in 55%, distance 4 in 15%; after distance 2 in 62.5%, distance 5 in 8%. So A03 to A04 gap shifted from 1 to 2 steps. Support 52/52.

LAG002 (A03→A11): before distance 3 (100%), after distance 4 (91%). Support 22/23 — few observations, weak.

LAG003 (A04→A04, repetition): before distance 3 in 40%; after distance 4 in 30%, distance 3 in 8%, distance 5 in 8.6%. Hmm, A04 repeats; the gap between consecutive A04 occurrences shifted from ~3 to ~4. Support 49/45.

LAG004 (A04→A11): before distance 2 in 23%, after distance 2 in 36%, distance 3 in 9.5%. Small change 0.081.

LAG005 (A10→A04): before distance 1 in 47%, distance 4 in 16%; after distance 2 in 51%, distance 1 in 23%. So gap shifted from 1 to 2.

LAG006 (A10→A11): before distance 3 in 81%; after distance 4 in 82%. Support 26/22 — few.

LAG007 (A11→A04): before distance 1 in 23%; after distance 2 in 32%. Support 49/46.

LAG008 (A11→A11): before distance 3 in 33%; after distance 4 in 47%. Support 23/25 — few.

Overall story: A new activity A01 appeared in the later window (not observed at all before), occurring in about 47 in 100 traces, positioned around the middle of the trace (median relative position ~0.34). It is inserted between A03 and A04: A03 now often leads to A01 (42% of A03's outgoing transitions) instead of directly to A04 (53% → 10%); A11 now mostly leads to A01 (76%) instead of A04 (96% → 22%); A10 now often leads to A01 (25%) instead of A04 (47% → 13%). This is consistent with A01 being inserted into existing sequences, pushing successors one step later.

So the main hypothesis: A01 was added (inserted) into the process, typically between A03/A10/A11 and A04, i.e., an activity became present that previously was not executed. This is a structural change: an activity added / a new step inserted.

Wait — but the guidance says: "A change in how often existing paths are taken requires that every activity and path involved is observed in a substantial share of traces in both windows...
